feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub recovered to its highest level since this year's drought began
entry.summary: Germany's own federal gauge network measured the Rhine at Kaub at 53 centimetres, up from a range of 10 to 20 centimetres logged through mid-October. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, direct reading, 26 October 2026

entry.title: Singapore's haze cleared to moderate across every region
entry.summary: Singapore's National Environment Agency recorded a 24-hour PSI of 67 to 72 across the north, south, east, west and central regions at 1pm local time, moderate everywhere. — Sources: National Environment Agency, Singapore, direct reading, 26 October 2026, 1pm SGT
